Secure .gov websites use HTTPS A lock ( Lock Locked padlock icon ) or https:// means you’ve safely connected to the .gov website. Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites. Did you notice that the Institute for a Healthier Heart website has a link to an online shop? That's a clue that the site's main purpose may be to sell something and not just to offer information. But the site may not explain this directly. You need to investigate! A site with a shopping cart as a main item on the page may be mostly interested in selling you something. The online store includes products from HeartDrugz, the company that funds the site. This clue suggests that the site might show a preference for the drug company or its products. Keep this in mind as you browse the site. On this page you can see that the site's sponsor is selling heart vitamins on the site. This could create a conflict of interest that influences the type of information that the website offers.
